structured.answer: The page shows about 179,889 ₪ in today's money after 15 years of 750 ₪ a month (135,000 ₪ put in), assuming 2% inflation a year, 7% return and the dollar staying put. The cheapest place it shows is an account at פסגות ניירות ערך holding "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)". I would ask my son before doing it.
